opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid access to BitClub mining through priced pool tiers and a stated $500 investment, while describing mining profits as renewable and payable indefinitely: "as long as you use a little bit of the profits to repurchase to some of these partial shares". It also presents income from recruiting purchasers, including five percent on introduced people's purchases and payments tied to multiple levels of sign-ups. The presenter directs viewers to register, obtain Bitcoin and set up a wallet, and instructs them to use a VPN so they appear to come from another country: "you need to use a VPN which will hide your IP address and change your IP address so that appears that you come from another country." Although the presentation qualifies outcomes by Bitcoin price and discusses tax reporting, those qualifications do not remove the paid investment and recruitment-based return structure.
